notes_tail: EU-wide data-protection coordination and major breach commentary. The /news/news_en feed is dominated by institutional announcements — material breach/enforcement items are rarer. For per-country enforcement, prefer the source country's DPA (CNIL FR, BfDI DE, Garante IT, AEPD ES) over the EDPB. | 2026-06-20 full audit (v2.62): live=Y, drill=Y. FETCH → bridge: python3 tools/fetch_source.py url https://www.edpb.europa.eu/news/news_en for the dated /news/news/2026/<slug>_en link list, then bridge url <article> for the body.. AVOID: WebFetch 403s the host — skip it, go straight to the bridge. Feed is mostly institutional announcements; material breach/enforcement items are rare..

Elastic Security research. 2026-05-08 audit: 5 dated articles 5-8 May 2026 (TCLBANKER, Traefik, AI hunting). | 2026-06-20 full audit (v2.62): live=Y, drill=Y. FETCH → webfetch https://www.elastic.co/security-labs (listing) then webfetch www.elastic.co/security-labs/<slug> for body. AVOID: Nothing — webfetch works cleanly on both listing and article.

… substantive threat-landscape work, also drill into /publications (annual ENISA Threat Landscape, sector-specific reports). Slow-cadence policy source — when the feed is empty in the window, flag as 'no items' rather than treating as fetch failure. 2026-05-08 audit: WebFetch returned 5 dated posts incl. 'New CVE Numbering Authorities' 2026-05-06. | 2026-06-20 full audit (v2.62): live=Y, drill=Y. FETCH → webfetch https://www.enisa.europa.eu/news (then webfetch per-article URL; for substantive work drill /publications). AVOID: Slow-cadence policy source — empty window is 'no items', not a fetch failure. /news skews exercises/policy; drill /publications for the actual Threat Landscape reports..

ESET research blog; particularly strong on European APT activity. RSS at https://www.welivesecurity.com/en/rss/feed/ mirrors the listing. 2026-05-08 audit: 5 dated posts latest 2026-05-07 on CallPhantom, ScarCruft. | 2026-06-20 full audit (v2.62): live=Y, drill=Y. FETCH → webfetch https://www.welivesecurity.com/en/ (listing) then webfetch per-article URL; RSS mirror at https://www.welivesecurity.com/en/rss/feed/. AVOID: No issues — WebFetch works on listing and detail. No bridge needed..

…ies (added 2026-05-08). 2026-05-08 audit: WebFetch returned 5 advisories all 2026-05-07 (rust-openssl, utcp-http, netbox, etc.). For per-ecosystem filtering use /advisories?type=...&query=...; for GraphQL / API see https://docs.github.com/en/graphql/reference/objects#securityadvisory. Candidate — promote to active after 3 runs. | 2026-06-20 full audit (v2.62): live=Y, drill=Y. FETCH → webfetch https://github.com/advisories (listing, dated GHSA items) then webfetch https://github.com/advisories/<GHSA-ID> for affected packages/CVE/severity/CWE. AVOID: Nothing to avoid for browsing; for programmatic/per-ecosystem filtering use /advisories?type=...&query=... or the GraphQL securityAdvisory API..

…le/threat-analysis-group 2026' to discover dated TAG posts, then webfetch the per-post https://blog.google/threat-analysis-group/<slug>/ URL (renders full body). The /security/rss/ feed exists but carries Android/consumer-fraud product posts, NOT the TAG threat-actor reports.. AVOID: Documented rss URL https://blog.google/threat-analysis-group/rss/ is dead (404) — do NOT use it. The section landing page (/threat-analysis-group/ and /technology/safety-security/threat-analysis-group) renders only one featured Android product post to WebFetch, not the TAG list — do NOT rely on the landing page for discovery. /security/rss/ and /technology/safety-security/rss/ are consumer-fraud feeds, not TAG..

… Substantive content is at the German-language CERT.at warnings list linked from the homepage. Reliability lowered to MEDIUM 2026-05-08 because direct WebFetch only returns navigation. | 2026-06-20 full audit (v2.62): live=Y, drill=Y. FETCH → rss (CERT.at warnings): feed https://www.cert.at/cert-at.de.warnings.rss_2.0.xml 5  — full advisory body (CVE/affected/mitigation/sources) is IN the RSS <summary>. German.. AVOID: govcert.gv.at/en/ homepage is navigation-only (no dated posts); /en/news/ is 404. The cert.at warning DETAIL pages are JS-rendered SPA shells (bridge returns ~3KB of nav chrome only) — do NOT drill the HTML detail page; the RSS summary already contains the full advisory text..

Mass-scanning and opportunistic-exploitation telemetry. | 2026-06-20 full audit (v2.62): live=Y, drill=Y. FETCH → webfetch (listing) then webfetch per-article URL for body. https://www.greynoise.io/blog lists dated posts; drill into /blog/{slug}.. AVOID: Listing dates can be slightly out of order (a research post dated April surfaced above June ops posts) — sort by date, don't trust top-of-page ordering..

Singapore-headquartered global CTI firm. WebFetch returns HTTP 403 (re-confirmed 2026-05-08); RSS at /blog/feed/ also 403. Bridge fetcher would need www.group-ib.com on its allowlist — not currently allowed because the publisher's WAF was observed to drop the bridge UA too in earlier tests. Surface as coverage gap. Retest periodically; recover to `active` if a CSAF/RSS becomes available. | 2026-06-20 full audit (v2. Remains a coverage gap; WebSearch-only discovery. Do NOT WebFetch or bridge — it will 503. Recover if a CSAF/RSS becomes available.

High-volume aggregator; good early-warning for breaking incidents (added 2026-05-08). Discovery — always trace to primary source before citing. RSS at FeedBurner is the cleanest dated index. (v2.55: rss_url verified — use `python3 tools/fetch_source.py feed https://feeds.feedburner.com/TheHackersNews [N]`) | 2026-06-20 full audit (v2.62): live=Y, drill=Y. FETCH → rss: python3 tools/fetch_source.py feed https://feeds.feedburner.com/TheHackersNews 5 (then webfetch the per-article thehackernews.com URL or trace to primary). AVOID: It is an aggregator — never cite directly; always trace to the primary source. FeedBurner feed is the cleanest dated index; no need to scrape HTML..

…e=Y, drill=N. FETCH → rss: python3 tools/fetch_source.py feed https://www.heise.de/security/feed.xml 5  (awareness/headline only — feed summaries are ~150 chars). AVOID: Do NOT WebFetch per-article heise.de/news/<slug>.html for body — heise+ paywall ("Sie benoetigen ein heise+ Paket"); for substance pivot to a corroborating publisher (e.g. the vendor PSIRT the item references).. | 2026-06-20 v2.64 fetch-waste review: feed item bodies are ~120-char teasers and per-article pages are TollBit-paywalled (HTTP 307) — neither the feed nor a drill yields a readable article body. DEMOTED as fetch-waste (fetching the feed cannot produce citable content). Recover only if heise exposes a full-text feed.
